The haunted construct known as the caterpillar carriage is composed of armored segments that flow over one another as the carriage inches forward. It has two forelegs that dig grooves into the ground, making way for the many wheels situated along its underside. **[Recall Knowledge - Construct](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)** ([Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=2), [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4)): DC 48 **[Unspecific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 46 **[Specific Lore](/Rules.aspx?ID=563)**: DC 43 [The Caterpillar Carriage](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2771) **Source** [Tian Xia World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=223) pg. 286 **Perception** +30; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=82) (imprecise) 100 feet **Languages** [Sakvroth](/Languages.aspx?ID=118), [Tien](/Languages.aspx?ID=43) **Skills** [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) +35, [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +30, [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) +30 **Str** +9 **Dex** +3 **Con** +7 **Int** +2 **Wis** +4 **Cha** +4 --- **AC** 42 **Fort** +33 **Ref** +29 **Will** +30 **HP** 380 **Immunities** death effects, disease, doomed, drained, fatigued, healing, nonlethal attacks, paralyzed, poison, sickened, unconscious, vitality, void **Resistances** physical 15 (except adamantine or orichalcum) **Weaknesses** electricity 15, orichalcum 15 **Like Clockwork **Trigger** The caterpillar carriage gains the slowed or stunned condition** **Effect** The carriage is quickened for 1 round.
 --- **Speed** 40 feet, burrow 40 feet, swim 20 feet **Melee** jaws +35 ([reach 15 feet](/Traits.aspx?ID=192)), **Damage** 4d10+17 piercing plus [Improved Grab](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=27) **Melee** wheel +35 ([Agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170)), **Damage** 4d8+17 bludgeoning **[Constrict](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=57)** 4d10+4 bludgeoning, DC 40 **Rescue** The caterpillar carriage absorbs a willing construct within its reach. That construct doesn't exist separately until the caterpillar carriage releases it as an Interact action or is destroyed. **Rock Tunneler** The caterpillar carriage can burrow through solid stone at a Speed of 20 feet. It can leave a tunnel if it desires, and it usually does. **[Trample](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=81)** Huge or smaller, wheel, DC 40
